title: Flip-graph non-convexity for once-punctured polygons
summary: The set of the triangulations with vertex set $X$ of a simple polygon $\mathrm{P}$ can be structured into a flip-graph $\mathcal{F}(\mathrm{P},X)$ whose edges connect two triangulations that differ by a single arc.
